setup.bullish: session low below or equal to the prior five observed-session lows
setup.bearish: session high above or equal to the prior five observed-session highs
setup.replacement: a fresh same-direction five-session extreme cancels and replaces the pending setup
setup.opposite_setups: tracked independently; simultaneous opposite entries are skipped

execution.intraday_confirmation_entry: next available 5m open after the confirming bar
execution.session_close_confirmation_entry: first available 5m open of the next observed session
execution.stop_ordering: adverse stop or setup invalidation wins when a 5m bar is ambiguous
execution.time_exit: last 5m close of the configured observed-session holding horizon

costs.base_description: frozen EMA 3/38 comparison convention: commission, one-tick slippage and spread allowance combined
costs.funding: signed official daily SWAPRATE times one USDRUBF contract; positive rate debits longs and credits shorts
costs.missing_funding: explicit adverse 0.0035 times entry price per required clearing; never zero-filled

benchmarks.one_day_monitor: operational v2 price/volume/OI rules with FUTOI omitted when unavailable; next-session entry and common 5-session exit for return comparison
benchmarks.ema_3_38: frozen USDRUBF_D_EMA3_38_mixedATR2_candidate_20261007 executed by an adapter against an untouched copy of its reproducibility code

anti_lookahead: setup is created only after its session closes
running VWAP and delta use rows no later than the confirming 5m bar
ATR and relative-volume baselines use earlier completed sessions
the final 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-09 holdout is not used for parameter selection
fold trades must exit inside their evaluation interval
protected_scope: frozen EMA strategy and reproducibility artifacts
